transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, it's nice to meet you too. Um, thank you for seeing me. I guess I'm here because... well, I just wanted to get some advice, if that's okay? It's probably not a huge deal, but I've been having a little trouble staying focused lately. 

Like, I'll be working on a project for school—I'm in college right now—and I just get pulled off track a bit. You know how it is, right? Like, a notification will pop up on my phone, or I'll hear a song lyric, or I'll just get a really good idea for something else I want to do. And then I kind of... lose the thread of what I was originally supposed to be working on. It's not terrible, I just thought maybe I could learn some better habits? Does that make sense?
Looking back, did you have this same kind of trouble staying focused when you were a child?

Um, yeah, I guess so? I mean, I was just a kid, so I think a lot of it was pretty normal childhood stuff. But, um, my mom kept some of my old report cards from elementary school, and the teachers would sometimes write little notes. Nothing horrible! Just, like, that I tended to rush through my worksheets, or maybe I'd miss some of the directions. 

And, um, sometimes during group work I might get a little too excited and talk over people? I really didn't mean to be rude, I just had a lot of energy, I guess. Is that the kind of thing you mean? 

Oh, and my parents... they were really supportive, so they would usually sit with me while I did my homework. Just to help me out, because otherwise I might, you know, wander off to go play or start drawing and forget to finish my math. But that's pretty normal for little kids, right? I hope I'm answering your question okay.
When you're trying to focus, do worries or anxious thoughts tend to pull your attention away?

Um, no, I don't think so. I mean, I worry about things sometimes, just like anyone else, right? Like if I have a big test coming up or if I'm running late. But it's not really the worry that distracts me. 

It's more like... my brain just wants to go in a different direction. It's not because I'm anxious, I just get interested in something else and forget I was supposed to be doing the first thing. I really don't think I'm an anxious person overall. I try to stay pretty positive! Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it right.
